title: FAILSPAN: Structural Mayhem
one_line: Build real-physics bridges in 2D or 3D, from Class 8 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then test the bridge with traffic. Build. Stress. Snap.
how_to_play: Pick your class, tap its building, answer questions to earn parts, tap two joints to place a member, then press Test bridge. Guide, Hint and Show me lead you step by step; Forces shows the pushes and pulls at any joint.
description:
FAILSPAN is a foundation for an engineering career where every lesson ends in a load test. A campus road leads from Class 8 to 12, then BE, NIT, IIT and Expert Engineer. Each building has its own questions, 17,000+ in all, across physics, chemistry, maths, geography, economics, commerce, accountancy, computer and engineering, plus a bridge quiz for every project and an Edge tab of hard questions from the class's whole syllabus.

Right answers earn parts, and each class has its own bridge to build, from a cable bridge in Class 8 to a two-tower bridge for a line of trucks in Class 12 and beyond. Real engineering maths checks every beam as the vehicles drive across: does it snap, get crushed or bend.

Build in 2D to learn the shapes, then switch to 3D: your bridge stands over a sunset canyon, real 3D vehicles cross it with a live stress meter, and every failure snaps with sparks, debris and slow motion, so you see which beam gave way and why. English and Bengali, guided steps, hints, stars, badges, a daily streak, a weekly challenge and a printable report card for teachers. Works offline once loaded.
controls: Tap a building to open its questions
Tap two joints to place a beam
Test bridge sends the traffic across
Switch between 2D and 3D at any time
Guide, Hint and Show me lead you step by step; Forces shows any joint
tips: Watch the slow-motion replay to find the beam that broke first.
Keep an eye on the live stress meter as heavy vehicles cross.
Triangles keep a bridge stiff; squares fold.
Use the Edge tab to revise before exams.
story: BridgeWorks taught the physics; FAILSPAN lets students feel it. Watching a bridge snap in slow motion shows why a beam broke better than a page of notes, and it turns Class 8 to engineering-level study into one path you play.
